column1: # Requirements proven by review, not by a test: the requirement, a tab, how it is verified.

column2: No new code starts a process without a time limit (the probe runs under ssh's ConnectTimeout and the callers' timeouts; osqueryi under `timeout`); paths are built with path.join. CI runs the suite on both boot-machine platforms and as a user who is not root: .github/workflows/ci.yml job "check" (Bun and Node) and job "suite" (matrix windows-latest, macos-latest).

The guide in src/archon/fleet/mod.ts and the command help are written with the change and read in review; bun run check:trace, check:layers, check:ontology and check:mizan run in CI (bun run ci) with their baselines, which only shrink.
